response.sql: WITH tx AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END AS signed_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1996-05-09' AND '1998-01-06'), regional AS (SELECT region, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM tx GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall_avg FROM regional) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed AS avg_signed_amount, r.tx_count AS transaction_count, r.avg_signed / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM regional r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
